comment: Estimates in seconds, used only to balance the shards and to order them (longest first). Measured on GitHub runners (ubuntu-24.04, 4 vCPU) in the runs of 2026-11-19, as the 'ok' seconds of `go test` in the shard logs: internal/lint 243, internal/adminapi 422, internal/store 138, internal/app 85, internal/worker/smssend 61, internal/admincli 45, internal/auth/session 34, internal/auth/login 26, and the oracle shards of internal/api 90 to 134 each (api_split is their mean), internal/api without them 555 to 620. internal/store/catalogtest 119 (run 44732890797, shard packages-2). The mutant numbers were measured in run 44732890797 (2026-11-20, six shards of 97 to 134 mutants, two at a time): the median time between two kills, doubled for the two workers, is 4 seconds per must_fail run of a plain mutant and 12 of a container one, and sixteen mutants take 30 to 414 seconds each (a Valkey or Postgres start-up that the test waits for) and are listed by id in mutant_seconds, which replaces the per-run cost of that mutant. Those sixteen were the long pole of the run: one shard took 24 minutes and the quickest 8, with six near-equal shards planned. The baseline numbers are not measured and stay at the defaults. A wrong value unbalances the shards and breaks nothing.
